name: deliberation
description: Offline jury deliberation app for a closed LAN

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.cloudflare:build: VITE_REALTIME=websocket npm run build && npm run admin:build
scripts.cloudflare:deploy: npm run cloudflare:build && npm run cloudflare:deploy:jury && npm run cloudflare:deploy:admin
scripts.cloudflare:d1:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply deliberation --local --config cloudflare/jury/wrangler.toml
scripts.cloudflare:d1:migrate:local:admin: wrangler d1 migrations apply deliberation --local --config cloudflare/admin/wrangler.toml
scripts.cloudflare:d1:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply deliberation --remote --config cloudflare/jury/wrangler.toml
scripts.cloudflare:d1:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute deliberation --local --file cloudflare/seed.local.sql --config cloudflare/jury/wrangler.toml
scripts.cloudflare:d1:seed:local:admin: wrangler d1 execute deliberation --local --file cloudflare/seed.local.sql --config cloudflare/admin/wrangler.toml
scripts.admin:dev: concurrently -k -n admin-server,admin-client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w court-admin-server" "npm run dev -w court-admin-client"
